_comment: R5-at-scale campaign. Each hole is a single-hole def-shell scaffold; N forced-diverse agents (distinct model families) each fill the ONE hole into an isolated checkout --multi scratch; diverge-report classifies observational divergence over Omega. Measures: under-constraint-witness rate (weak/intentional holes), convergence rate (tight holes), sibling-suppression incidence (should be 0 for def-shell after v0.14.9), spurious-witness soundness (a witness requires >=2 fills that BOTH verify against the real solver, so it cannot be manufactured). Requires llmll >= 0.14.9 (sibling-call classification fix) — a stale binary false-nulls transfer_helper.
_cmd_note: agy replaced the gemini CLI (Antigravity). --model takes the display string from `agy models`. codex gpt-5.5 uses bare `codex exec` (no --model) on ChatGPT-tier. claude model id is claude-opus-4-8. Confirm each CLI is logged in before a LIVE run; use --mock first to validate the pipeline with zero spend.

agents.name: claude-opus-4-8
agents.cmd: claude -p --dangerously-skip-permissions --model claude-opus-4-8 'Read AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md and complete the task.'

agents.name: gpt-5.5
agents.cmd: codex exec --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox 'Read AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md and complete the task.'

agents.name: gemini-3.1-pro
agents.cmd: agy -p 'Read AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md and complete the task.' --model 'Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)' --dangerously-skip-permissions
